description.text: Inside a cramped garage, a bare work lamp hangs low over an open engine bay, its hot white pool catching the grit on the cylinder head and the cracked rubber of a drive belt. The older mechanic, sleeves shoved to the elbow and hands darkened by oil, leans across the fender. He straightens just enough to jab a calloused finger at the frayed belt, fixing the argument on that failed part while his jaw works and his eyes stay hard. The younger man is a tense presence at the edge of the light, boots planted on stained concrete. Tools lie scattered on a steel bench, and the engine ticks softly as it cools.
The work lamp hums over the open engine bay; oil sheen and belt fibers catch the light.
The older mechanic leans closer, then straightens and thrusts a finger toward the cracked belt.
His finger taps the belt's frayed edge once, sharply, holding the younger man's attention there.
A ratchet clinks against the bench, and the engine ticks as metal contracts.
The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed.

The younger mechanic steps into the lamp's reach, a rag bunched in one hand. He drags it slowly over his knuckles, wiping away dark grease while he meets the older man's stare. His shoulders stay square, but his head shakes once, a small refusal, and his mouth sets before he answers. Behind him, the older mechanic's jaw tightens; the work lamp throws both men's shadows across a pegboard crowded with wrenches. The garage feels narrower, the air close with oil and heat. On the concrete, boots shift as the younger man settles his weight.
The younger mechanic enters the work lamp's pool; the rag is dark with grease.
He wipes his knuckles slowly, then lowers the rag and meets the older man's eyes.
A single shake of the head refuses the older mechanic's verdict; the older man's jaw tightens.
Boots scrape on concrete; the rag drags over knuckles; the engine ticks continue.
The camera holds a static shot.
